ability.viltrumitecore.rohan_heavens_doo: The stand touches a body within 5 blocks (9 with an ink mark) and opens it as a book: read the truth, write instructions. Press again to close the book; with nobody in reach it calls or dismisses the stand. 20 ink.
Draws Pink Dark Boy in the air (0.8 s). For 4 s up to 4 bodies within 12 blocks that look at the drawing open as books. Blind, sleeping, enraged and blinded bodies are immune. 35 ink.
ability.viltrumitecore.rohan_pen_nibs.de: Flicks three G-pen nibs (16 blocks, 2 damage each). A hit leaves an ink mark for 6 s: Heaven's Door reaches the marked body from 9 blocks. 6 ink.
ability.viltrumitecore.rohan_faster_than: For 0.6 s the stand waits with an open palm. The first melee hit never lands: the attacker opens as a book for 2 s with "Cannot attack Rohan Kishibe" already written. 20 ink.
ability.viltrumitecore.rohan_self_edit.d: The stand writes on his own cheek: "flies backwards at 70 km/h". He shoots back 10 blocks and shakes off slowness, nausea and any hold. 15 ink.
Ultimate (100 Inspiration). He raises a finished page (1.5 s): up to 8 bodies within 14 blocks in front of him that see it open as books for 5 s. One line is written into all of them. Inspiration comes from reading new kinds of books.
scan.viltrumitecore.rohan.stand: Stand Heaven's Door: reads and rewrites bodies
codex.viltrumitecore.rohan.name: Rohan Kishibe
codex.viltrumitecore.rohan.role: Manga artist of Morioh and his stand Heaven's Door
codex.viltrumitecore.rohan.lore: A proud, curious manga artist who will do anything for reality in his work. His stand, a small boy in a long coat and a top hat, turns anyone who sees his drawing or is touched by it into a living book: every page is the truth of their life, and whatever Rohan writes into it they must obey.
codex.viltrumitecore.rohan.gameplay: Ink (0-100) pays for everything except the ultimate, which needs Inspiration from reading new kinds of books. Heaven's Door opens one body by touch; Air Sketch and the Manuscript open whoever looks. In the book you read real data and write lines from a fixed list: Safety Lock, forget the target, keep away, stand still, spare villagers, guard, go to, no attacks of a kind, fly backwards, follow, calm. Bosses and strong heroes give short windows, one line, resist and throw lines back; S+ books are read-only.
codex.viltrumitecore.rohan.relations: He would love to read DIO's book; the city's citizens are his favourite material.
